googleDrivePrivacy.title: Passwordless E2EE Encryption
googleDrivePrivacy.description: To ensure strict zero-knowledge end-to-end encryption without a password: your secret vault key is stored in a private, hidden folder of your Google Drive (appDataFolder). GlassFolio cannot access any of your personal files, and our servers can never decrypt your financial data.
googleDrivePrivacy.item1Text: Strictly zero access to your documents, photos, or personal Drive files.
googleDrivePrivacy.item2Text: Your devices sync automatically through your authenticated Google session.
